For every admissible s and omega the explicit positive-rate fiber a=A+2u, b=c=A-u, kappa=sqrt(omega²/3+3u²), u∈[0,u*) and u*=(sqrt(3A²-2omega²/3)-A)/2, preserves all eigenvalues, stationary law and activity. Along it sigma is continuous, attains the lower endpoint, and diverges as b-kappa and c-kappa decrease to zero, proving the entire half-line image by IVT. Direct rational characteristic checks and finite numerical path checks 28293 total are secondary; no numerical infinity proof claimed.

value.rationale: The inverse thermodynamic question is natural: determine every allowable stationary energy-dissipation cost from the measured damped oscillatory pair when stationary weights and mean jump activity are known. A complete sharp half-line classification for all admissible pairs, including a constructive fixed-spectral path to unbounded EPR, demonstrates strong nonidentifiability despite a compulsory positive floor. This supplies an exact reference benchmark and a sharp limitation of spectral entropy-cost inference, beyond a one-off counterexample.
